id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

name.description: User specified name of this health calculation job.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

operation.description:
Reference to the {@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Operation} instance that implements the health calculation function
to use.
See {@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Operation#calculateHealth} for details.

title:
{@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Job} is used to calculate the health of many {@link MlModel}s. All models should be within the
scope of a single {@link MlProject}.
The execution is essentially a map-reduce (primarily map) over {@link #models}, using {@link #operation}. The overall
execution status is tracked in {@link MlModel.HealthCalc.JobRun}, and the execution status of individual batches are
tracked in {@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Result}. The health values are stored in {@link MlModel.Health.History}.

Usage:
```python
# assumes a pre-defined health calculation `MyApp.MyModelHealthCalc` and a filter on all models
job = c3.MlModel.HealthCalc.Job(name="my_health_job", operation=c3.MyApp.MyModelHealthCalc(lookback=3)).create()
run_handle = job.start(modelFilter="true")
job_run = run_handle.result()
job_run.summary()
```
name: MlModel.HealthCalc.Job
